theories.claim: ReconcileInterruptedMutation and RecoverQA transition QA to Interrupted/Stale without holding QA writer fence, allowing race where concurrent RunQA Publish overwrites recovered state after Reconcile reads flow but before SaveRecoveredState
theories.basis: locks.go:25-97 acquires sprint mutation lease via acquireMutationContext but uses empty fence (store created with default nil fence for SaveRecoveredState); qa.go:178-248 RecoverQA also uses acquireMutationContext and then store.SaveRecoveredState which does not call checkWriter, unlike Publish which requires fence; concurrent RunQA holds same lease type but lease is per-Service instance in-memory plus file lock so cross-process race depends on file lock timing
theories.confirmation_condition: concurrent RecoverQA and RunQA on same sprint with file lock contention shows recovered state overwritten after RunQA Publish or SaveRecoveredState succeeds while RunQA holds lease
theories.refutation_condition: acquireMutationContext serializes all mutations via file lock acquisition; RecoverQA retry returns ErrVerificationConflict and does not write, or SaveRecoveredState validates fencingGeneration and aborts
theories.inconclusive_condition: no concurrent mutation executed; single-threaded read-only inspection only
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: read locks.go, qa_state.go SaveRecoveredState, service.go acquireMutation; inspect lock acquisition order and whether SaveRecoveredState calls checkWriter; search for fence usage without executing concurrent workers

theories.claim: QAInvestigatorRequest path allowlist is constructed from normalized shard ChangedPaths+ContextPaths but does not bound duplicate or excessive path rules; large context expansion could exceed PromptBytes after policy serialization though prompt itself is checked
theories.basis: qa_prompt.go:182-193 loops over normalized paths and appends PermissionPathRule per entry; qa_map.go caps ContextPathsPerShard at Budgets limit but investigator output later allows ContextRequests up to ContextExpansions*PathsPerExpansion which are not pre-validated against runtime policy size; RenderQAInvestigatorPrompt checks prompt bytes but not policy rule count bytes
theories.confirmation_condition: shard with maximum ContextPathsPerShard (64) plus follow-up expansions creates policy with >128 allow rules and serialized runtime request exceeds PromptBytes or runtime rejects request
theories.refutation_condition: runtime Request serialization size is bounded by same Budgets.PromptBytes or service truncates/rejects excessive path rules before StartRun
theories.inconclusive_condition: no runtime request serialization measured; read-only prompt and policy inspection only
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: read qa_prompt.go and qa_types.go DefaultQABudgets; count max path rules from Default vs Maximum budgets and inspect runtimeRequest metadata assembly without invoking runtime

theories.claim: RunQA evidence publication builds plans and runs ApprovedQAChecks for every Completed shard but does not verify shard ApprovedChecks ownership before descriptor selection, allowing stale check catalog to be used if target grows new .go files between map and evidence phase
theories.basis: qa.go:476-504 ApprovedQAChecks is recomputed from current target and changedPaths inside buildQAEvidencePublication and again per shard; descriptor fingerprint is taken from live filesystem (gofmt -d <current go list>) while map holds frozen CheckCatalogFingerprint; ValidateQAEvidencePlan checks attempt binding but not that descriptor matches shard.ApprovedChecks set
theories.confirmation_condition: adding a new .go file to target after QAMap but before evidence phase changes ApprovedQAChecks descriptor (different Args/fingerprint) yet evidence plan is still frozen and accepted
theories.refutation_condition: FreezeQAEvidencePlan or publishEvidence rejects descriptor whose fingerprint is not in qaMap.CheckCatalogFingerprint and shard.ApprovedChecks, causing admission error
theories.inconclusive_condition: no live target mutation executed; read-only file listing only
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: read qa.go, qa_prompt.go, qa_state.go publishEvidence; list target go files before and after map without mutating; compare ApprovedQAChecks fingerprint to map CheckCatalogFingerprint
